short_title: What phosphate rock and phosphogypsum contain (2018)
title: Characterization of phosphate rock and phosphogypsum from Gabes phosphate fertilizer factories (SE Tunisia): high mining potential and implications for environmental protection
summary: Analysed the chemistry and minerals of phosphate rock and phosphogypsum. Both carry high loads of trace elements. The authors estimate yearly flows of contaminants to the sea and argue the waste could be reprocessed instead of dumped.

findings.headline: Yearly contaminant flows to the sea are estimated per substance
findings.summary: Estimated annual flows of phosphogypsum contaminants into the marine environment range from 0.05 t (rhenium) to 87,249.60 t (fluoride).
